e.title: Triple-I（美国保险信息协会）
e.summary: 美国保险业数据与洞察机构：议题简报、州级可负担性指数、Fact Book 类行业统计
e.summary_en: US insurance data and insight body: issues briefs, a state-level affordability index and Fact Book-type industry statistics
e.summary_hk: 美國保險業數據與洞察機構：議題簡報、州級可負擔性指數、Fact Book 類行業統計
e.body: Triple-I（Insurance Information Institute，`iii.org`）自我定位为「**The Trusted Voice of Risk and Insurance**」，是**美国保险业的数据与公众洞察机构**（与 [[aiai-designation]] 所属的 The Institutes 同源体系）。站内可核实栏目：**Insurance Types**（按险种，如 Auto、Homeowners & Renters）、**Preparedness & Claims**、**Insights & Trends（数据与趋势）**、News & Events、Members、About Us；发布物包括 **Triple-I Index（追踪各州保险可负担性趋势的指数）**、**Triple-I Blog**、**Triple-I Issues Briefs（议题简报，如「法律体系滥用如何推高社会性通胀」）**、州级市场分析（如「State of the State: California Homeowners Insurance」）、以及 Executive Exchange 对话视频（如与 [[munich-re]] 的对谈）。对 RIAA：这是**「保险业如何被公共讨论」的样本**——它把行业数据翻译成公众与政策语言，其中**可负担性指数（affordability by state）与社会性通胀（social inflation）议题简报**是美国市场分析的高频切入点；数据侧与监管数据（[[naic-financial-data-repository]]、[[naic-ai-oversight]]）形成「监管原始数据 vs 行业加工洞察」的配对，巨灾与保障侧可接 [[hurricaneguard]]、[[fema-nfhl-mcp]]、[[claims-risk-scoring-dataset]]；对理解「保险可信度与公众沟通」这一职业议题也有直接价值（对照 [[iii-underwriter-ai-talent]] 一类人才与行业研究）；适合作美国市场分析、行业议题研究与政策沟通方向。
e.body_en: Triple-I (Insurance Information Institute, `iii.org`) describes itself as "**The Trusted Voice of Risk and Insurance**" and is **the US insurance industry’s data and public-insight body** (from the same family as The Institutes, home of [[aiai-designation]]). Verifiable sections include: **Insurance Types** (Auto, Homeowners & Renters and more), **Preparedness & Claims**, **Insights & Trends**, News & Events, Members and About Us; its publications include the **Triple-I Index** (tracking insurance affordability trends by state), the **Triple-I Blog**, **Triple-I Issues Briefs** (e.g. "How legal system abuse drives social inflation"), state-level market analyses (e.g. "State of the State: California Homeowners Insurance") and Executive Exchange video conversations (for instance with [[munich-re]]). For RIAA: a sample of **how the insurance industry is discussed publicly** — it translates industry data into public and policy language, and its **affordability index and social-inflation issues briefs** are high-frequency entry points for US market analysis; on data it forms a "regulatory raw data vs industry-processed insight" pairing with [[naic-financial-data-repository]] and [[naic-ai-oversight]], while catastrophe and protection topics connect to [[hurricaneguard]], [[fema-nfhl-mcp]] and [[claims-risk-scoring-dataset]]; it is also directly useful for understanding "insurance credibility and public communication" as a professional theme (compare talent and industry research such as [[iii-underwriter-ai-talent]]); suits US market analysis, industry-issues research and policy communication.
e.body_hk: Triple-I（Insurance Information Institute，`iii.org`）自我定位為「**The Trusted Voice of Risk and Insurance**」，是**美國保險業的數據與公眾洞察機構**（與 [[aiai-designation]] 所屬的 The Institutes 同源體系）。站內可核實欄目：**Insurance Types**、**Preparedness & Claims**、**Insights & Trends**、News & Events、Members、About Us；發布物包括 **Triple-I Index（追蹤各州保險可負擔性趨勢）**、**Triple-I Blog**、**Triple-I Issues Briefs（議題簡報）**、州級市場分析與 Executive Exchange 對話視頻。對 RIAA：這是**「保險業如何被公共討論」的樣本**——把行業數據翻譯成公眾與政策語言，其中**可負擔性指數與社會性通脹議題簡報**是美國市場分析的高頻切入點；數據側與監管數據（[[naic-financial-data-repository]]、[[naic-ai-oversight]]）形成「監管原始數據 vs 行業加工洞察」的配對；巨災與保障側可接 [[hurricaneguard]]、[[fema-nfhl-mcp]]、[[claims-risk-scoring-dataset]]；適合作美國市場分析、行業議題研究與政策溝通方向。
